leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a Node.js project with a package.json file for managing dependencies.
Configure environment variables using a .env file to store sensitive data securely.
Integrate the dotenv package to load secrets into the application's runtime environment.
Construct a configuration module that centralizes access to environment variables.
Apply validation logic to ensure required secrets are present before the application starts.
Manipulate the application's startup sequence to load secrets before other modules execute.
Implement a secure pattern for accessing secrets in different parts of your Node.js application.
